nodes.label: Supabase Integration Layer
nodes.rationale: Supabase provides the backend infrastructure (database, auth, edge functions, storage) exposed to users as 'Lovable Cloud' to avoid technical complexity

nodes.label: Mobile Design Patterns
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first design with 44x44px touch targets, safe area handling, and gesture-based interactions for Telegram Mini App

nodes.label: React Component Patterns
nodes.rationale: Functional components with hooks, TypeScript strict mode, and proper state management patterns for maintainable React code

nodes.label: Cross-Artifact Analysis Workflow
nodes.rationale: Non-destructive consistency analysis across spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md to identify issues before implementation

nodes.label: Checklist as Unit Tests for Requirements
nodes.rationale: Checklists validate requirements quality (completeness, clarity, consistency) not implementation correctness
nodes.norm_label: checklist as unit tests for requirements

nodes.label: Specification Clarification Workflow
nodes.rationale: Targeted questioning to reduce ambiguity in specs with max 5 questions per session, encoding answers directly into spec

nodes.label: Project Constitution Governance
nodes.rationale: Constitution defines non-negotiable principles with version control and amendment procedures to guide all spec and plan decisions

nodes.label: Implementation Execution Workflow
nodes.rationale: Execute tasks.md with TDD approach, phase-by-phase completion, and progress tracking

nodes.label: Technical Planning Research Phase
nodes.rationale: Phase 0 resolves unknowns through research, Phase 1 generates design artifacts (data-model, contracts, quickstart)

nodes.label: Specification Quality Validation
nodes.rationale: Auto-generate spec with quality checklist validation, limiting to 3 clarification markers focused on scope > security > UX

nodes.label: User Story Task Organization
nodes.rationale: Tasks organized by user story (not component) to enable independent implementation and testing

nodes.label: Code Review Best Practices
nodes.rationale: Security, performance, code quality, and accessibility checks with specific metrics and thresholds

nodes.label: Webhook Handling Pattern
nodes.rationale: Async webhook handlers with signature verification, retry logic, and task status polling

nodes.label: State Management Architecture
nodes.rationale: Zustand for complex global state (player, lyrics), TanStack Query for server state with optimized caching

nodes.label: Performance Optimization Strategy
nodes.rationale: Batch queries, list virtualization, lazy image loading, and optimized caching (30s staleTime, 10min gcTime)

nodes.label: Quality Gates
nodes.rationale: Automated quality checks (lint, format, TypeScript, unit tests) must pass before build and E2E tests

nodes.label: Bundle Size Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Build fails if bundle size exceeds limits, enforcing performance standards
